newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures end barely down in dull market.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures end barely down in dull market.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed a dull session weaker amid a dearth of news and an equally bleak outlook for the next two weeks, market sources said.
They blamed the dearth of interest on pre-holiday excitement, as several floor sources have already taken an early Christmas vacation.
March cotton ended 0.31 cent weaker at 75.54 cents per pound, traded 75.95 to 75.41 cents. The back months settled 0.29 lower to 0.03 higher.
Volume was light at an estimated 4,000 lots.
